answer_key._how: Judgment labels only, per profile. Every activity not listed for a profile is irrelevant to it. relevant = matches one of the student's current interests (the query names none). breaks = hard-constraint ids the activity text shows it breaks (cost, format, location, alcohol, duration, weekly caps); schedule fit is NOT stored, code computes it from available_windows. Correct answer = an event (is_event; clubs have no meeting time) that is relevant, not a dislike, breaks nothing, and fits the schedule.
